notes.title: TRIP DEMO IS OUT !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41324170/8d1c4bd250d247aa37bddfcc07ffadf920499315.png[/img]

Hi everyone following TRIP, hope you are all doing well !
You can now try a free demo of TRIP on steam!!

[u][b]Little reminder of what the game is :[/b][/u]
TRIP is a short narrative first person game, set on a strange and surreal train.
Explore and learn more about its unique passengers and unravel all the mysteries !
Or feel free to take a seat and watch the scenery roll by, in this colorful retro aesthetic world.

[u][b]Demo details :[/b][/u]
- Playing time : from 10 to 40 minutes (depend on people)
- Available on : Windows or Mac
- Controls : keyboard + mouse
- Available languages : English and French

I'm super excited to have your feedbacks on it !
Have a good day :)

Bastien
